edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = tx.origin, making ownership depend on a phishable origin address.
tx.origin value flows into the owner state variable used by all owner-only functions.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the source of the transfer.
transferFrom compares msg.sender against _from for allowance spend.
approve writes allowance keyed by msg.sender.
delegate authorization relies on msg.sender == owner.
distribute authorization relies on msg.sender == owner.
list authorization relies on msg.sender == owner.
block.timestamp influences execution path and router deadline in list.
